description.value:
You unleash a blast of freezing air in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 2d6 cold damage and suffer 1 slowed level until the end of its next turn; a successful save halves the damage and negates the slow.

Cast with a 2nd-level slot or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1st, and the slowed levels inflicted on a failed save rise to 2 at 3rd level, 3 at 5th level, and 4 at 7th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
